name: OpenAL Soft
what_it_is: An LGPL-licensed, cross-platform software implementation of the OpenAL 3D audio API.
platforms: Linux, Windows, Android, OS X, iOS and more
notable: Release 1.25.2 is announced on the site

facts.fact: OpenAL Soft is an LGPL-licensed, cross-platform, software implementation of the OpenAL 3D audio API.
The EFX extension adds air absorption, occlusion and environmental reverb to the API.
OpenAL Soft supports mono, stereo, 4-channel, 5.1, 7.1, HRTF, UHJ and B-Format output.
The site lists OpenAL Soft 1.25.2 as the current release, and support is offered through IRC and a GitHub issue tracker.

name: miniaudio
what_it_is: A single-file C and C++ audio playback and capture library with a node-graph engine and 3D spatialization, in the public domain.
platforms: Windows, macOS, iOS, Linux, BSD, Android and Web (Emscripten)
pricing: Free; public domain or MIT No Attribution, at your choice.
key_features: Node graph for mixing and effects

facts.fact: miniaudio is an audio playback and capture library for C and C++ made of a single source file with no external dependencies.
miniaudio is released into the public domain, with MIT No Attribution as an alternative license.
The high level engine places sounds in a 3D scene with spatialization, built on a node graph and resource manager.
miniaudio works on Windows, macOS, iOS, Linux, BSD, Android and Web through Emscripten.

name: SoLoud
what_it_is: A free, easy-to-use C and C++ audio engine for games with bindings for several languages.
platforms: C and C++ with C-API bindings for Python, Ruby, C#, D and others; Emscripten
key_features: Filters such as echo and low/high pass
notable: The author says it has no artist tools, only limited engine integration, and no console backends in the package

facts.fact: SoLoud is released under the ZLib/LibPNG license and can be used in free or commercial applications.
The author says SoLoud has no artist tools, limited engine integration, and no vendor support compared with FMOD or Wwise.
Console backends are not included in the package because of SDK license issues, though the author says software using SoLoud has shipped on current-gen consoles as of 2018.
The license page states SoLoud proper is a clean-room implementation under the ZLib/LibPNG license, with bundled parts under Unlicense, CC0, WTFPL or public domain terms.

name: Krotos Studio
what_it_is: Sound design software and libraries for creating sound effects, including creature voice, weapon, vehicle and real-time transformation plugins and an AI Video to Sound feature.
platforms: Plugins for Premiere Pro and DaVinci Resolve workflows; plugin formats not listed on the opened pages
pricing: Plans are listed on a pricing page whose amounts were not readable in the opened text.
notable: Krotos says its software has been used on Stranger Things, Game of Thrones and AAA games

facts.fact: Krotos Studio offers Pro and Max platforms plus iconic plugins: Dehumaniser 2, Weaponiser, Reformer Pro, Igniter and Simple Monsters.
The site offers Video to Sound for Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve and a browser version.
Krotos says its software has powered titles such as Stranger Things, Game of Thrones and countless AAA games.
The pricing page has Start Free Trial buttons, but the opened text shows no amounts.
